messages:
sam.prod: Quick thread to decide GA autoscale + burst defaults. Exec wants a clear conservative default and a path for customer opt-ins. Can we agree?
toni.eng: I propose conservative GA defaults: cooldown=300s, hysteresis=15%, burst_headroom=15% of pool, prewarm_formula = ceil(pool_gpus*0.15). Keep hourly carryover post-GA.
jasper.infra: +1 but require AZ spread guard: no more than 80% of an AZ allocated to reserved pools. Also add a regional cap: no single region can take >30% of global burst headroom by default.
mila.se: For pilots we need a simple UX: burst meter, refill ETA, and a toggle for carryover opt-in. SEs can demo without hourly carryover if the meter + forecast are solid.
evan.sales: Pilot ask: at least two customers want hourly windows. we'll take them as pilot opt-ins; billing must be explicit.
billing-bot: Note: add billing SKU mapping for burst_metered and carryover_credit. recommend default carryover_off.
sam.prod: Draft acceptance checklist for GA:
- latency SLO validated under conservative burst in two regions
- autoscale defaults set (cooldown=300s, hysteresis=15%)
- burst_headroom default 15% with opt-out contract flag
- AZ spread and regional caps documented and enforced
- telemetry: dedicated.burst.tokens, dedicated.prewarm.count, dedicated.spillover.count
- billing mapping documented (reserved_commit, burst_metered, carryover_credit off by default)
toni.eng: I'll run a short simulation of conservative defaults across typical tenant mixes and post results. Due Wed.
jasper.infra: I'll produce capacity projections for us-west and eu-west showing AZ spread effects. Due Wed noon.
mila.se: I'll deliver UX mock for burst meter and carryover toggle. Due Thu.
evan.sales: I'll line up pilot opt-ins and confirm which need hourly windows (pilot-only). Due Thu EOD.
sam.prod: If all items green, we mark hourly carryover as post-GA pilot and ship GA with conservative defaults. Thanks :thumbsup:
__notes: Short product thread; messages concatenated per agents.md rules
